```yaml
name: Publish Docs

on:
  push:
    branches: [main]
  workflow_dispatch:

permissions:
  contents: read
  pages: write
  id-token: write

jobs:
  publish-docs:
    runs-on: ubuntu-latest
    environment: github-pages
    steps:
      - name: Checkout repository
        uses: actions/checkout@v4

      - name: Set up Python
        uses: actions/setup-python@v5
        with:
          python-version: '3.12'

      - name: Set up uv
        id: uv
        uses: pytorch/test-infra/.github/actions/setup-uv@main
        with:
          python-version: '3.12'
          enable-cache: true
          github-token: ${{ secrets.GITHUB_TOKEN }}
          ignore-empty-workdir: true
          cache-dependency-glob: '**/uv.lock'
          cache-suffix: uv
          restore-cache: true
          save-cache: true

      - name: Install dependencies
        run: ${{ steps.uv.outputs.uv-path }} sync --dev

      - name: Run tests
        run: ${{ steps.uv.outputs.uv-path }} run pytest

      - name: Build docs
        run: ${{ steps.uv.outputs.uv-path }} run mkdocs build

      - name: Upload artifact
        uses: actions/upload-pages-artifact@v3
        with:
          path: site

      - name: Deploy to GitHub Pages
        uses: actions/deploy-pages@v4
```
